_about: Status-line literals collectors may write without a CollectorStatusText builder, each with why it must stay as written. Read by scripts/check_collector_status_text.py; an entry whose literal is gone fails, so this list can only shrink. Literals are normalized: interpolations and printf specifiers become {}.

entries.reason: "Compute Points" is Abacus AI's own billing unit, the same term scripts/quota_tier_names.json passes through for its tier, so the line keeps matching the vendor's billing page.

Zen is OpenCode's product name; the segment is an amount plus that name, with no word of ours to translate. The rest of the line goes through builders.
DIEM and its epoch allocation are Venice's own token and staking terms (the tier passthrough "DIEM Balance" in scripts/quota_tier_names.json is the same decision).

"Edit Predictions" is Zed's product name, passed through as a tier name in scripts/quota_tier_names.json; the plan name in front is Zed's too. The overdue-invoices segment appended after it goes through a builder.
